gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor/outcome/admi.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` answers `admitted` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.Deposit/invariant/at/gate.purpose: every `gatepass.visit.Deposit` that `gatepass.visit.ExpectedVisits` publishes at `deposit` satisfies what the type declares

gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/outcome/ref.purpose: `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` answers `refused` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit/outcome/reg.purpose: `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` answers `registered` for an input that satisfies that branch's guard

gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor/outcome/si.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` answers `signed-out` for an input no other branch's guard claims

gatepass.visit.Visit/invariant/after/gat.purpose: a `gatepass.visit.Visit` still satisfies what it declares after `gatepass.visit.RegisterVisit` on `registered`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/Departed/refu.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Departed`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`
`gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Departed`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/Expected/refu.purpose: `gatepass.visit.SignOutVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `Expected`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`

gatepass.visit.Visit/state/OnSite/refuse.purpose: `gatepass.visit.AdmitVisitor` does not move a `gatepass.visit.Visit` that is in `OnSite`, and reports `gatepass.visit.VisitStateConflict`
